description: This Java class implements a servlet named SeoCatalogUrlServlet that handles incoming HTTP requests to generate SEO-friendly URLs for products and categories in an e-commerce application. It processes URL path info to identify product and category IDs, sets related request attributes, manages category trails, and forwards requests to appropriate view components. Additionally, it provides static methods to construct such URLs based on given parameters.

classes.name: SeoCatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet handling SEO-friendly URL processing for product and category navigation, including URL parsing, trail management, and forwarding to views.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for processing.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests by parsing URL paths to identify product and category IDs, setting request attributes accordingly, and forwarding to the appropriate JSP view.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs an SEO-friendly URL for a product and category trail based on current context, previous category, and product IDs.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs an SEO URL given a context path, breadcrumb trail, product ID, current, and previous category IDs.
